cases.original_question: Asupra terenurilor aflate in proprietatea terţilor, cuprinse in zonele de protecţie si de siguranţa ale capacităţilor energetice, se stabileşte pentru deţinătorul capacităţilor energetice:
cases.A_reason: A temporary/free right of use for works differs from permanent legal servitude established on third-party land in statutory safety/protection zones.
cases.B_reason: The right does not transfer the landowner's property to the capacity holder.
cases.C_reason: Art.15(3) expressly establishes legal servitude for third-party land inside protection and safety zones.

primary_exact_source.document: Legea nr.123/2012, Portal Legislativ consolidated displayed 2026-11-22
primary_exact_source.exact_legal_object: Matched original question on its exact statutory subject and action
primary_exact_source.adjacent_context: Art.15(1) establishes protection/safety zones and (2) their technical determination, while (3) states the limited legal servitude.

cases.original_question: O persoană care deţinea în proprietate sau în folosinţă o reţea electrică de distribuţie proprie la data intrării în vigoare Legii nr,123/2012:

original_ABC.A: nu are obligaţii privind asigurarea accesului la reţea
original_ABC.B: este obligată să asigure accesul la reţea numai pentru producători de energie electrică din surse regenerabile
original_ABC.C: este obligată să asigure accesul la reţea, conform reglementărilor autorităţii competente

cases.A_reason: No-access-obligation contradicts the owner’s express statutory obligation.
cases.B_reason: Only renewable generators would arbitrarily exclude other users and contradict nondiscriminatory network access.
cases.C_reason: Art.46(1) requires owner/user of pre-existing private distribution network to ensure access according to the authority’s rules.

primary_exact_source.document: Legea nr.123/2012, Portal Legislativ consolidated displayed 2026-11-22
primary_exact_source.exact_legal_object: Matched original question on its exact statutory subject and action
primary_exact_source.adjacent_context: Art.46(2) additionally imposes operator handover when serving users becomes impossible; not automatic surrender for all existing private networks.

cases.original_question: Finanţarea lucrărilor de electrificare a localităţilor este obligaţia:

original_ABC.C: operatorului de distribuţie în executarea contractului de concesiune

cases.A_reason: Local authorities request plans and may cofinance; statute does not solely impose all funding on local councils.
cases.B_reason: The ministry may have cofinancing/budget role but is not exclusively responsible.
cases.C_reason: Art.51(1) imposes operator development and funding obligation under concession, if requested and within geographical/licence plan conditions.

primary_exact_source.document: Legea nr.123/2012, Portal Legislativ consolidated displayed 2026-11-22
primary_exact_source.exact_legal_object: Matched original question on its exact statutory subject and action
primary_exact_source.adjacent_context: Art.51(2) expressly allows cofinance local/state and applicant funds; do NOT teach an absolute operator-only funding model.

cases.original_question: Pot face obiectul unei concesiuni energetice:

original_ABC.A: bunurile proprietate publică sau privată a statului
original_ABC.B: bunurile aflate în proprietatea oricărui operator econimic
original_ABC.C: bunurile utilizate în activitatea de furnizare a energiei electrice

cases.A_reason: Art.19(1) includes State publicly or privately owned assets among possible energetic concession subjects.
cases.B_reason: Any economic operator’s privately owned assets are not automatically State public concession objects.
cases.C_reason: Merely used in electricity supply does not by itself establish State concession qualification.

primary_exact_source.document: Legea nr.123/2012, Portal Legislativ consolidated displayed 2026-11-22
primary_exact_source.exact_legal_object: Matched original question on its exact statutory subject and action
primary_exact_source.adjacent_context: Art.19(1) also includes certain public services/activities, while (2)-(3) identify State contracting authority and transmission exceptions.

cases.original_question: Criteriile de promovare a energiei electrice produse in centrale electrice de cogenerare de înalta eficienta au in vedere:

original_ABC.B: realizarea unui randament global anual de minimum 50% în cazul unităţilor de cogenerare cu puteri electrice instalate de peste 25 MW

cases.A_reason: Art.71(2)(c) explicitly includes efficient use of fuels as criterion for high-efficiency cogeneration promotion.
cases.B_reason: A blanket 50% annual efficiency for >25 MW is not this article’s listed criterion and mixes separate performance rules.
cases.C_reason: Promotion of renewable sources is regulated in paragraph (1), not the specific cogeneration-paragraph (2) asked.

primary_exact_source.document: Legea nr.123/2012, Portal Legislativ consolidated displayed 2026-11-22
primary_exact_source.exact_legal_object: Matched original question on its exact statutory subject and action
primary_exact_source.adjacent_context: The preceding Art.71(1) separately concerns renewable-energy promotion; next Art.72 addresses support schemes for both.

cases.original_question: Energia electrica tranzactionata pe piata de energie electrica se masoara de catre operatorii de masurare, prin grupuri de masurare, conform reglementărilor elaborate de:

original_ABC.B: ANRE - Autoritatea Naţională de Reglementare în domeniul Energiei
original_ABC.C: ANRSC - Autoritatea Naţională de Reglementare in domeniul Serviciilor Comunale

cases.A_reason: The line ministry is not the regulatory issuer of the measurement code in this provision.
cases.B_reason: Art.65(1) requires metering according to the measurement code developed by ANRE.
cases.C_reason: ANRSC is not the electricity market metering-code authority.

primary_exact_source.document: Legea nr.123/2012, Portal Legislativ consolidated displayed 2026-11-22
primary_exact_source.exact_legal_object: Matched original question on its exact statutory subject and action
primary_exact_source.adjacent_context: Art.65(2)-(4) differentiates transformer allocation and which network operators must provide metering services; the question asks who sets the code.

original_ABC.A: Exploatează, retehnologizează, reabilitează si dezvolta reţelele electrice de distribuţie, cu respectarea reglementarilor tehnice in vigoare
original_ABC.B: Exploatează, retehnologizează, reabilitează si dezvolta reţelele electrice de iluminat public

cases.A_reason: Art.45(1)(a) imposes operation, modernisation, rehabilitation and development of electricity distribution grids within technical and environmental standards.
cases.B_reason: Public lighting infrastructure is not the generally defined object of the electricity distribution-operator duty in this clause.
cases.C_reason: Billing/collecting electricity supplied is the supplier’s commercial role, not the regulatory role stated for distribution operator.

primary_exact_source.document: Legea nr.123/2012, Portal Legislativ consolidated displayed 2026-11-22
primary_exact_source.exact_legal_object: Matched original question on its exact statutory subject and action
primary_exact_source.adjacent_context: Art.45 subsequent provisions detail capacity, access, metering and nondiscriminatory distribution; no general permission to treat public lighting as electricity distribution concession.

cases.original_question: Reţea electrică de interes public este o reţea electrică la care sunt racordaţi cel puţin:
cases.A_reason: Three is more restrictive than the expressly defined minimum and misses networks with only two users.
cases.B_reason: Statutory definition is at least 2 users connected.
cases.C_reason: One user fails the minimum of two.

primary_exact_source.exact_legal_object: Matched original question on its exact statutory subject and action
primary_exact_source.adjacent_context: Art.3 adjacent definitions distinguish distribution grid, public-interest grid and transmission network.

cases.original_question: Conform prevederilor referitoare la energia electrică din Legea nr. 123/2012 , noţiunile de "client final" şi "consumator" sunt:

original_ABC.C: echivalente numai în cazul consumatorilor casnici

cases.A_reason: Statute explicitly equates the terms in its electricity domain, so not generally distinct.
cases.B_reason: Art.3 pct.20 says «client final» and «consumator» are equivalent in the law.
cases.C_reason: The equivalence is not limited only to household clients; commercial/nonhousehold clients also qualify.
